name: accompany-desktop
description: Accompany をブラウザではなく専用のウィンドウで開くデスクトップアプリ（試作）

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/main.ts --outfile dist/main.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build src/preload.ts --outfile dist/preload.cjs --target node --format cjs --external electron && bun build src/start.ts --outfile dist/start.js --target browser && cp src/start.html dist/start.html && cp ../server/src/public/apple-touch-icon.png dist/icon.png
scripts.start: bun run build:server && bun run build && electron .
scripts.package: bun run build:server && bun run build && bunx @electron/packager@20.3.0 . Accompany --platform darwin --arch arm64 --out out --overwrite --app-bundle-id io.github.itsuki-yamada.accompany --extra-resource ../server/dist --ignore '^/(src|out)($|/)' && codesign --force --deep --sign - out/Accompany-darwin-arm64/Accompany.app
